Privacy

Updated September 30, 2026.

Quiz answers

Your budget, recipient, age band, interests, and gift-style answers stay in the page’s memory. This version does not send those answers to a server, store them in a database, or save them in cookies or browser storage. Reloading the page resets them.

Accounts and analytics

This site does not offer visitor accounts, collect email addresses, or run a visitor analytics script. The hosting provider may process ordinary request information to deliver and secure the website under its own privacy practices.

Amazon shopping links

Shopping links lead to Amazon and include an affiliate tracking ID. Clicking a link sends you to Amazon, which may use cookies and process your activity under its own policies. Good Guess does not receive your Amazon payment details or your quiz answers through these links.

Read Amazon’s Privacy Notice and OpenAI’s Privacy Policy for the hosting provider.

Advertising

The two advertisement spaces are placeholders. No AdSense or other advertising-network script currently loads on this site. If a network is enabled later, this notice will be updated to describe its cookies, partners, and available choices.

Changes

The date above identifies the current notice. Review this page when the site adds features.
